purpose: Diagnose the depth-64 boundary with denser temporal checkpoints and layerwise gradient/residual dynamics. Descriptive/confirmatory mechanism study, not a formula search.
pairing: Same task, depth, seed, initialization and train/test sampling stream across activations.
primary_diagnostic_question: In depth-64 boundary cells, do rising global or layerwise gradients and residual/activation imbalances emerge before the late loss of PreCap test advantage?
decision_boundary: No formula, optimizer, task, seed, step schedule, or post-hoc efficacy gate changes after launch.
